summary: The filing is a Form 6-K from Glass House Brands Inc., a foreign private issuer, reporting first quarter 2026 financial results. The press release discloses revenue of $40.5 million, gross profit margin of 25%, negative adjusted EBITDA of $(4.2) million, and reiterates full-year production guidance of ~1,000,000 pounds. There are no special-situation elements such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, restructuring, or other corporate action. The filing is purely a routine earnings update and does not trigger a special-situation classification.
